title: The Anxious Generation
author: Jonathan Haidt
summary: Social psychologist Jonathan Haidt argues that the shift from play-based childhood to a phone-based one, from about 2010, drove a rise in teen anxiety and depression. He suggests rules for parents and schools.
readIf: you are a parent, teacher or reader who wants a clear case for limiting phones and social media for children.
skipIf: you want a neutral look at the research or are unconvinced that phones are the main cause.
